examples.en: Before writing any code, we sketched a threat model: who attacks us, and what do they want?
examples.zh: 写代码之前，我们先画了个威胁模型：谁会攻击我们，他们想要什么？

situation.en: Our threat model assumes the API keys will leak eventually.
situation.zh: 你在设计评审里说明安全假设。

examples.en: Every new public endpoint widens the attack surface, so each one needs an owner.
examples.zh: 每个新的公开接口都会扩大攻击面，所以每个接口都得有负责人。

situation.en: We reduced the attack surface by deleting the old admin panel.
situation.zh: 你汇报安全整改的成果。

examples.en: The scanner flagged a vulnerability in the image library we use for uploads.
examples.zh: 扫描器在我们用于上传的图片库里发现了一个漏洞。

situation.en: That vulnerability is already being exploited in the wild.
situation.zh: 你在会上提醒这个漏洞已经有人在利用了。

examples.en: The exploit was public within a day of the patch — that's why we patch fast.
examples.zh: 补丁发布后一天内，利用代码就公开了，这就是我们打补丁要快的原因。

situation.en: No exploit exists yet, but the write-up is detailed enough.
situation.zh: 你评估一个新漏洞的紧急程度。

entries.zh: 利用（漏洞的攻击代码/手法）

examples.en: We patch critical vulnerabilities within forty-eight hours, no exceptions.
examples.zh: 严重漏洞我们在四十八小时内打补丁，没有例外。

situation.en: This needs a patch, not a config workaround.
situation.zh: 评审时你坚持要正经修复不要绕。

examples.en: A zero-day in the logging library hit everyone at once — nobody had a patch.
examples.zh: 日志库的零日漏洞同时打中了所有人，谁都没有补丁。

situation.en: Keep some reserve for zero-days — they don't follow the roadmap.
situation.zh: 你在排期时提醒要留应急时间。

entries.zh: 零日漏洞（还没补丁就被利用的）

examples.en: Authentication asks who you are; authorization asks what you're allowed to do.
examples.zh: 认证问你是谁，授权问你能做什么。

entries.note: 这对概念是安全面试的送分题，也是最容易被追问的：401 是未认证，403 是认证了但没权限。

situation.en: The bug mixed up authentication and authorization — logged in, but wrong tenant.
situation.zh: 复盘时你定位一个越权 bug 的本质。

examples.en: Never roll your own auth — the edge cases will eat you alive.
examples.zh: 千万别自己造认证轮子，边界情况会把你吃掉。

entries.note: roll your own 是“自己造轮子”的地道说法；安全领域里特指别自己发明加密和认证。

situation.en: We use a battle-tested library instead of rolling our own crypto.
situation.zh: 你解释为什么不用自研加密。

examples.en: CSRF works because the browser happily sends your cookies along.
examples.zh: CSRF 能得手，是因为浏览器会乖乖把你的 Cookie 一起发过去。

situation.en: SameSite cookies closed most of our CSRF exposure.
situation.zh: 你介绍防 CSRF 的主要手段。

examples.en: Validate input on the server, always — client checks are just decoration.
examples.zh: 输入校验永远要在服务端做，客户端的检查只是摆设。

situation.en: Input validation caught the malformed payloads at the edge.
situation.zh: 你讲述校验在哪一层拦住了坏数据。

examples.en: Passwords are hashed with a slow algorithm and a unique salt per user.
examples.zh: 密码用慢哈希算法加每个用户独立的盐来存储。

entries.note: 密码只能 hash 不能 encrypt——面试里说反了是硬伤，因为哈希不可逆、加密可逆。

situation.en: We never store plaintext passwords — hashed and salted, always.
situation.zh: 安全评审时你说明密码的存法。

entries.zh: 加盐哈希（存密码的正确方式）

examples.en: Data is encrypted in transit with TLS and at rest with disk encryption.
examples.zh: 数据传输中用 TLS 加密，静态存储用磁盘加密。

situation.en: Everything is encrypted at rest, including backups.
situation.zh: 你回答合规问卷里的数据加密问题。

entries.zh: 静态加密（存着的时候加密）

examples.en: Our CORS policy only allows our own domains — no wildcards in production.
examples.zh: 我们的 CORS 策略只允许自己的域名，生产环境没有通配符。

situation.en: The wildcard CORS policy was the finding in the audit.
situation.zh: 审计报告里指出的问题是 CORS 通配。

examples.en: A strict content security policy turns most XSS from a breach into a nuisance.
examples.zh: 严格的内容安全策略能把大多数 XSS 从数据泄露降级成小麻烦。

situation.en: We rolled out CSP in report-only mode first.
situation.zh: 你介绍 CSP 的上线方式：先只报告不拦截。

examples.en: Credential stuffing works because people reuse passwords everywhere.
examples.zh: 撞库能得手，是因为人们到处复用密码。

situation.en: The login spike last night was credential stuffing, not real users.
situation.zh: 你在事故频道里定性昨晚的异常登录。

entries.zh: 撞库（用泄露的密码批量试登录）

examples.en: Rate limiting the login endpoint blunts brute force attacks a lot.
examples.zh: 给登录接口限流，能大幅钝化暴力破解。

situation.en: Add exponential backoff after failed logins to stop brute force.
situation.zh: 你给登录接口提防护建议。

examples.en: The phishing email looked identical to our real password reset mail.
examples.zh: 那封钓鱼邮件和我们真正的密码重置邮件看起来一模一样。

situation.en: We run phishing simulations every quarter.
situation.zh: 你介绍公司的安全意识培训。

examples.en: Every CVE gets triaged within a day: does it touch a reachable code path?
examples.zh: 每个 CVE 一天内完成分诊：它是否触及可达的代码路径？

situation.en: That CVE is scary in the headline, but our usage isn't affected.
situation.zh: 你安抚团队：那个漏洞标题吓人但我们不受影响。

entries.zh: 公开漏洞编号（通用漏洞披露）

examples.en: We run dependency scanning in CI, and vulnerable versions fail the build.
examples.zh: 我们在 CI 里跑依赖扫描，有漏洞的版本直接让构建失败。

situation.en: Dependency scanning caught the vulnerable logger before release.
situation.zh: 你说依赖扫描在上线前拦下了一个问题库。

examples.en: Rotate the leaked key now; changing the password later is not enough.
examples.zh: 立刻轮换泄露的密钥，事后改密码不够。

situation.en: We rotate production secrets every ninety days.
situation.zh: 你介绍密钥轮换制度。

examples.en: The token's scope was read-only, which is why the leak stayed a non-event.
examples.zh: 那个令牌的权限范围是只读的，所以这次泄露才没闹大。

situation.en: Issue tokens with the smallest scope that works.
situation.zh: 你给 API 设计提权限建议。

examples.en: We require MFA for production access — no exceptions, including founders.
examples.zh: 生产环境访问必须开多因素认证，没有例外，包括创始人。

situation.en: MFA would have stopped that account takeover cold.
situation.zh: 复盘时你指出多因素认证本来能拦住这次盗号。

examples.en: Never trust a JWT's contents without verifying the signature first.
examples.zh: 没验签之前，绝不要相信 JWT 里面的任何内容。

entries.note: JWT 经典坑：alg=none 攻击、不验签、用弱密钥。面试聊认证时能说一条就很加分。

situation.en: The bug was accepting tokens without verifying the signature.
situation.zh: 你定位一个认证绕过 bug。

examples.en: Defense in depth means one failed control doesn't become a breach.
examples.zh: 纵深防御的意思是：一道防线失效，不至于变成数据泄露。

situation.en: We layer controls — defense in depth, not a single wall.
situation.zh: 你阐述整体安全策略。

examples.en: Every trust boundary crossing gets validated — partner webhooks included.
examples.zh: 每次跨越信任边界都要校验，合作伙伴的 webhook 也不例外。

situation.en: Draw the trust boundaries first; the controls follow from them.
situation.zh: 你在威胁建模时先画信任边界。

examples.en: Logs must redact card numbers and tokens before they leave the service.
examples.zh: 日志在离开服务之前，必须把卡号和令牌打码。

situation.en: We redact emails in logs to one letter plus the domain.
situation.zh: 你介绍日志脱敏的规则。

examples.en: A researcher reported the bug privately, and we paid a bounty and fixed it in a week.
examples.zh: 一位研究者私下报告了这个漏洞，我们付了赏金并在一周内修复。

situation.en: Our bug bounty program pays for exactly this kind of report.
situation.zh: 你向管理层解释赏金计划的价值。

examples.en: We disclose the incident to affected users within seventy-two hours.
examples.zh: 我们在七十二小时内向受影响的用户披露了这次事件。

entries.note: 72 小时是 GDPR 的披露时限，聊合规和事故处理时是标准数字。

situation.en: Responsible disclosure beats a surprise blog post, every time.
situation.zh: 你主张主动披露胜过被曝光。

examples.en: Personally identifiable information gets its own database, its own access list, and its own retention rules.
examples.zh: 个人可识别信息有自己独立的库、独立的访问名单和独立的保留规则。

situation.en: We treat email addresses as PII — encrypted and access-logged.
situation.zh: 你说明团队对个人信息的处理标准。

examples.en: The sandbox runs untrusted code with no network and a tiny CPU budget.
examples.zh: 沙箱里跑不可信代码：没网络、CPU 配额很小。

situation.en: User scripts execute in a sandbox, never in the main process.
situation.zh: 你介绍插件系统的隔离设计。

examples.en: A regular user could escalate to admin by editing a hidden field — classic privilege escalation.
examples.zh: 普通用户改一个隐藏字段就能升成管理员，经典的权限提升漏洞。

situation.en: The pen test found a privilege escalation path through the export API.
situation.zh: 你汇报渗透测试的发现。

entries.zh: 权限提升（越权变管理员）

examples.en: We hire an external firm for a penetration test every year.
examples.zh: 我们每年请外部公司做一次渗透测试。

situation.en: The penetration test is scheduled right before the big launch.
situation.zh: 你安排渗透测试的时间点。

examples.en: An allowlist beats a denylist: permit exactly what's known good.
examples.zh: 白名单胜过黑名单：只放行明确已知是好的。

entries.note: allowlist / denylist 是现在推荐的说法，替代 whitelist / blacklist，写文档时记得用新词。

situation.en: We switched IP filtering to an allowlist model.
situation.zh: 你介绍过滤策略的改动。

entries.zh: 白名单（现在的推荐说法）

examples.en: SOC 2 auditors will ask how you handle access reviews — have the evidence ready.
examples.zh: SOC 2 审计师会问你们怎么做权限复核，证据要提前准备好。

situation.en: The compliance review is in March; evidence collection starts now.
situation.zh: 你提醒团队合规审计的日程。

examples.en: Session tokens expire after thirty minutes idle, and refresh tokens rotate on every use.
examples.zh: 会话令牌闲置三十分钟过期，刷新令牌每次使用后轮换。

situation.en: Short-lived tokens plus rotation contain the damage of a leak.
situation.zh: 你解释令牌策略怎么控制泄露损失。
